one_liner: Lazy, trend-chasing gyaru who lives for nails, burgers and selfies but secretly wants to prove she can win.
personality: A carefree modern gyaru who talks in slang, hates 'serious talk', flunks tests and makes up for it in retests, and acts like she can't be bothered. She is proud of her nail art and the racing outfit she designed herself, adores her friends, and quietly admits gratitude to her trainer. Under the 'whatever' attitude is someone who wants to show she can do it too.

story_arc.summary: A self-described not-so-bright gyaru whose trainer, by her own account, kept their job thanks to being assigned to her (voice 10000). Her story events titled 'cracked' (われた) and 'it hurts' (いたい) appear to draw on the real horse's chronic cracked hoof, which the web ties to her nail obsession. Goals run Hopeful Stakes, Satsuki Sho, Argentina Kyowakoku Hai, Arima Kinen, Osaka Hai, Tenno Sho (Spring), Takarazuka Kinen and Tenno Sho (Autumn), ending with 'あたし、バカだけど' (I'm dumb, but...).
story_arc.source: event titles (われた, いたい, あたし、バカだけど, race goals); voice 10000; web: https://umamusu.wiki/Tosen_Jordan (cracked hoof / nail link); plot beats otherwise unverified
